Definition: from G2474; an "Israelite", i.e. descendant of Israel (literally or figuratively):--Israelite.
BiblicalUsage: Israelites are the descendants of Israel, and the apostles address them as their own people. In Acts 2:22 Peter cries, ye men of Israel, hear these words, in Romans 9:4 Paul says the adoption and the glory belong to the Israelites, and in 2 Corinthians 11:22 he asks, are they Israelites, so am I.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name is a claim of belonging: Peter and Paul stood up and said, these are my people, and I am one of them.
